# BroTin Box

> BroTin Box is a measured, high-protein meal delivery service in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Meals are cooked fresh every morning in our Kuniyamuthur kitchen, every ingredient is weighed, and calories, protein, carbs and fat are printed on every box. Free delivery, Monday to Saturday, lunch (11:30 AM to 1:30 PM) and dinner (7:00 to 9:00 PM).

## What we offer

- Full box: a large, high-protein meal for gym-goers and active people
- Lite box: about 450 kcal, for lighter appetites and weight loss
- Veg and non-veg menus. Mains rotate through grilled chicken, pepper chicken steak, grilled mackerel, boiled eggs, paneer tikka, tofu tikka, smashed soya and creamy mushroom, with legume sides (black chana, rajma, kollu sprouts), salads, curd sides and measured carbs (chapati, oats dishes)
- Plans: one-day trial, 6-day weekly plan, 26-day monthly plan (Sunday kitchen closed)
- 26-Day Monthly Plan price per meal: Full box Rs 269 non-veg / Rs 249 veg; Lite box Rs 179 non-veg / Rs 159 veg. Second meal on the same day: Rs 10 off. Current prices and offers: https://www.brotinbox.com/pricing
- Order by 9:00 PM the night before. Pause or skip days before the cutoff; plan days are not lost

## Delivery areas (Coimbatore)

Kuniyamuthur, Kovaipudhur, Sundarapuram, Ukkadam, RS Puram, Race Course, Ramanathapuram, Saibaba Colony, Gandhipuram, Lakshmi Mills and Nava India. Ganapathy, Singanallur, Peelamedu and Vadavalli are in the next delivery batch.
